sources.title: Pachirisu — Scarlet & Violet 68/198（Everyone Discharge）
sources.documentVersion: Card text as printed (Limitless card page); cross-checked against the Rainier card database 2026-10-09
sources.supportsZh: “This attack does 20 more damage for each of your Benched {L} Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness.”：计算伤害时跳过弱点，抵抗力照常。

sources.title: Zapdos — Sun & Moon Team Up 40/181（Thunderous Assault）
sources.documentVersion: Official international card database; English card text cross-checked against the Rainier card database 2026-10-09
sources.supportsZh: 同一写法的太阳月亮年代印刷：只写 Weakness，没有写 Resistance。

sources.title: Pokémon TCG Rulebook — damage calculation order
sources.documentVersion: Official rulebook (Attack step: apply Weakness, then Resistance)
sources.supportsZh: 弱点与抵抗力是伤害计算里两个独立的步骤，招式可以只跳过其中一个。

dataContractZh: AttackDefinition 新增末尾字段 ignoresWeakness（旧数据默认 false，另有旧签名的兼容构造器）。不能与 ignoresWeaknessAndResistance 或 ignoresResistance 同时声明（两者都无视时写 ignoresWeaknessAndResistance），也只能用于攻击对方战斗宝可梦（或含战斗宝可梦的任选／全体）招式。
serverAuthorityZh: ServerMatch 两条伤害管线（对方战斗宝可梦；任选／全体时的战斗宝可梦）在这个字段为真时跳过弱点；复制招式时带上被复制招式的这个字段，声明复制的招式本身不能带。
